item.text: {"iteration":3,"pcvs":[{"name":"uses_rotary","expression":"int(rotary_emb is not None)","rationale":"Separates fixed rotary operator overhead from the cross-attention baseline."},{"name":"self_attention_work","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * (hidden_states.shape[1] + 2 * attn.inner_dim) if encoder_hidden_states is None else 0","rationale":"Combines quadratic attention work with linear projection work, giving self-attention an independent fitted coefficient."},{"name":"cross_attention_work","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * (hidden_states.shape[1] * encoder_hidden_states.shape[1] + attn.inner_dim * (hidden_states.shape[1] + encoder_hidden_states.shape[1])) if encoder_hidden_states is not None else 0","rationale":"Captures cross-attention pair work and query/context projection work independently of self-attention."},{"name":"self_attention_tail","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * (hidden_states.shape[1] % 16) if encoder_hidden_states is None else 0","rationale":"Retains a separate feature for the apparent self-attention remainder cost."}],"hypothesis":"Independent self-attention and cross-attention work estimates may explain their different scaling better than shared token slopes. Combining linear and quadratic work also captures increasing marginal cost at larger sequence lengths."}
